unit_of_replication: one stimulus seed: one realisation of the Poisson input (and of the null graph where graph_null.seed = replicate) on one fixed connectome and parameter set. Seeds are not animals; their spread is the model's sensitivity to its own input noise.

units.fraction_spiking: fraction of the population with >= 1 spike
units.latency_median_ms: median over the population's neurons of the first spike at or after the earliest stimulus onset (ms); missing when no neuron spiked

evidence.label: ASSUMED
evidence.applies_to: every simulated value, difference and interval in this file, read as a statement about the fly
evidence.rationale: a model output is no stronger than the weakest label of its inputs (order weakest first: ['UNKNOWN', 'ASSUMED', 'ENGINEERED', 'LEARNED', 'LITERATURE_DERIVED', 'EMPIRICAL'])

statistics_method.ci_mean: BCa bootstrap over replicates (percentile fallback if replicates are not finite); flylab.experiments.stats
statistics_method.paired: same seed in condition and reference; mean difference (BCa), Cohen's d_z (percentile), relative change mean(d)/mean(ref) (paired percentile), two-sided sign-flip permutation test (exact for <= 16 pairs)

multiple_comparisons.family: every comparison and population contrast x metric in this file with a p-value

intact.description: matched baseline, 100 Hz forced Poisson spikes in the 12 left LB3c

stim_right.description: mirror input, 100 Hz in the 11 right LB3c (Q19)

no_stimulus.description: no input at all (the model has no noise; expected silent)

silence_lb3c.description: positive control, output of the stimulated GRNs blocked for the whole run

silence_bridges.description: output of the 5 excitatory disynaptic LB3c_L -> MN9_L bridges blocked

sign_fast_ionotropic.description: sign table fast_ionotropic_v1 (modulatory transmitters unknown, histamine -1)

sign_predicted_nt.description: per-body predicted_nt column instead of consensus_nt

unknown_as_excitatory.description: unknown-sign presynaptic neurons (histamine, unclear, missing) excitatory

null_graph.description: degree-preserving shuffled graph, a new shuffle per seed
